topic: What beamforming strategies maximize capacity in high-throughput satellites while minimizing ground terminal complexity for cost-sensitive users?
response: To maximize capacity in high-throughput satellites while minimizing ground terminal complexity for cost-sensitive users, employ linear precoding with phase perturbation compensation. Use adaptive beamforming techniques such as Maximum Ratio Combining (MRC) or Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE) to optimize antenna array weights. Implement digital channelizers for flexible frequency reuse and interference mitigation.
